Usage: archgate check [options] [files...]

Run ADR compliance checks

Arguments:
  files              Only check rules relevant to these files

Options:
  --staged           Only check git-staged files
  --base [ref]       Compare changed files against a base ref (auto-detects when
                     omitted)
  --adr <id>         Only check rules from a specific ADR
  --verbose          Show passing rules and timing info
  --strict           Treat any rule-severity warning, and advisory findings
                     (briefing-budget, suppression, unparsed-ADR warnings), as
                     failures
  --output <format>  Output format: console (default), json, github, or sarif
                     (choices: "console", "json", "github", "sarif")
  -h, --help         display help for command

Usage: archgate review-context [options]

Pre-compute review context with ADR briefings for changed files

Options:
  --staged           Only include git-staged files
  --base [ref]       Compare changed files against a base ref (auto-detects when
                     omitted)
  --run-checks       Include ADR compliance check results
  --domain <domain>  Filter to a single domain
  --verbose          Include each ADR's Decision and Do's/Don'ts prose (large;
                     omitted by default — use `archgate adr show <id>` to drill
                     down)
  --strict           Exit 1 when ADR briefings were truncated or, with
                     --run-checks, when check found strict-relevant findings
  -h, --help         display help for command
